business_problem: Adobe needed an AI-ready data foundation that could support embedded generative AI features across its creative products without forcing users or internal developers to leave core workflows.
solution_summary: Adobe uses MongoDB Atlas as an all-in-one data layer for the AI capabilities it is embedding across products such as Adobe Creative Cloud and Acrobat. The Developer Foundations team needed a platform that could store application data, support retrieval for AI tasks such as chatting with PDFs, and let internal developers build new tools without stitching together separate storage and search systems. Atlas gives Adobe a single platform for storage, vector-enabled retrieval, and persistent search context so AI features can access the right data with minimal latency and high reliability. That simplifies how developers prototype and ship new capabilities because they can stay inside one operational platform rather than moving data between multiple tools. The result is a foundation that supports creative workflows with embedded AI, helping users preserve momentum inside Adobe applications while giving engineering teams a faster way to deliver new intelligent product experiences.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Provides the unified storage and retrieval platform behind Adobe’s embedded AI features and internal AI application development.

data_flow: Product and document data stay in MongoDB Atlas, where Adobe’s AI features retrieve the necessary context for experiences such as chatting with PDFs and then return responses directly inside Creative Cloud and Acrobat workflows.
business_outcome: Adobe can keep AI inside core creative workflows, maintain user momentum, and let internal developers build new AI solutions more quickly on a single platform.
